## Purpose
The day/night toggle. A click cycles light → dark → system; its menu picks one directly or returns to the Settings default.

## Responsibilities
- Uses `useTheme`, `nextMode`, and `themeStore.set(mode | null)`.
- The icon shows what is on screen; "system" adds a monitor badge.

## Key elements
`ThemeToggle`.

## Control flow
React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.

## Data, state and side effects
localStorage (`ui-color-mode`), through `lib/theme`.
